# Blackrose Branding

> Blackrose Branding designs, prints and installs physical branding for homes and businesses in South Africa: event branding, car wraps, vinyl and decals, wallpaper, corporate gifting and branded gazebos.

## Contact
- WhatsApp / phone: +27 83 874 7567
- Email: traymond565@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/brandingwithraymic
- Quotes: send a WhatsApp with what you need branded, where, by when, and photos of the space or vehicle.

## Services
- Events: media walls, branded counters, stage sets and backdrops for launches, expos and conferences.
- Car Wraps: cut-vinyl lettering and wraps for cars and fleets.
- Vinyl & Decals: shopfront graphics, window frosting, signage lettering and decals for glass, walls and other smooth surfaces.
- Wallpaper: custom printed wallpaper and feature walls for homes and offices.
- Corporate Gifting: branded gifts and merchandise for clients and teams.
- Gazebos: fully branded gazebos for markets, sports days and outdoor events.

## Portfolio highlights
Conference stage and lounge sets, wrapped retail display plinths, vehicle door lettering, shopfront fascia signs and menu boards, LED stage branding, outdoor exhibition activations, beauty launch backdrops, photo booth props, illuminated entrance signs with privacy frosting, decorative window frosting and branded bar counters.
